title: GroupCoOp: Group-robust Fine-tuning via Group Prompt Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating worst-case group accuracy (WORST) and weighted average group accuracy (INDIST) on image datasets (Waterbirds, Metashift) where target object classes are spuriously correlated with specific backgrounds (e.g., water/land or indoors/outdoors).

Evaluating worst-case group accuracy (WORST) and weighted average group accuracy (INDIST) for facial attribute classification (CelebA, MultiCelebA datasets) across male and female demographic subgroups.
Evaluating worst-case group accuracy (WORST) and weighted average group accuracy (INDIST) for facial attribute classification (MultiCelebA dataset) across young and old demographic subgroups.

Evaluating worst-case group accuracy (WORST) and weighted average group accuracy (INDIST) across sub-populations within target classes using the BREEDS benchmark to measure model robustness to intra-class subgroup imbalances.
